votes.question: On Motion to Concur in the Senate Amendments — An Act to amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to allow early childhood educators to take the educator expense deduction, and for other purposes (H R 5334)
votes.plain_language: The House voted to accept the Senate's rewrite of H.R. 5334, which imposes Russia-related sanctions and tariffs, extends an Iran sanctions law, and also expands a teacher tax deduction to early-childhood educators. A Yea accepts that Senate version. A Nay rejects it.

lobbying.bill_title: An Act to amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to allow early childhood educators to take the educator expense deduction, and for other purposes

votes.question: On Agreeing to the Resolution — Directing the President, pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution, to remove United States Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran (H CON RES 93)
votes.plain_language: This resolution tells the President to remove U.S. forces from hostilities with Iran unless Congress authorizes it, except for forces needed to defend against an imminent attack if the President follows the War Powers Resolution's time limits. A Yea agrees. A Nay rejects it.

lobbying.bill_title: Directing the President, pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution, to remove United States Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Whistleblower Protection Act (H R 4646)
votes.plain_language: This bill extends whistleblower protections to employees of Housing and Urban Development contractors and grantees, including on contracts signed before 2013. A two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Table — Impeaching Donald John Trump, President of the United States, for high crimes and misdemeanors (H RES 1486)
votes.plain_language: The resolution would impeach President Trump over Immigration and Customs Enforcement and Customs and Border Protection practices that it says violate the Constitution. This vote was a motion to table, which kills the resolution. A Yea tables it; a Nay would have left it pending.

lobbying.bill_title: Impeaching Donald John Trump, President of the United States, for high crimes and misdemeanors.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Local Communities & Bird Habitat Stewardship Act (H R 3276)
votes.plain_language: This bill writes into law the Urban Bird Treaty program, including grants to help cities conserve birds. A two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

lobbying.bill_title: Local Communities & Bird Habitat Stewardship Act

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Proposing an amendment to the Constitution of the United States to require that the Supreme Court of the United States be composed of nine justices (H J RES 1)
votes.plain_language: This resolution proposes a constitutional amendment fixing the Supreme Court at nine justices. A two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports that amendment; a Nay opposes it.

lobbying.bill_title: Proposing an amendment to the Constitution of the United States to require that the Supreme Court of the United States be composed of nine justices

votes.question: On Agreeing to the Resolution — In the matter of allegations relating to Representative Chuck Edwards (H RES 1498)
votes.plain_language: This resolution censures Representative Chuck Edwards of North Carolina. A Yea votes to censure him. A Nay votes not to.

lobbying.bill_title: In the matter of allegations relating to Representative Chuck Edwards.

votes.question: On Passage — To amend the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2023 to extend the time period for which certain regulations concerning the North Atlantic right whale are effective (H R 9436)
votes.plain_language: This bill moves the deadline for new lobster- and crab-gear rules meant to protect North Atlantic right whales from 2028 to 2035. A Yea passes it. A Nay votes no.

lobbying.bill_title: To amend the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2023 to extend the time period for which certain regulations concerning the North Atlantic right whale are effective

votes.question: On Motion to Recommit — To amend the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2023 to extend the time period for which certain regulations concerning the North Atlantic right whale are effective (H R 9436)
votes.plain_language: H.R. 9436 would move the deadline for new lobster- and crab-gear rules meant to protect North Atlantic right whales from 2028 to 2035. This vote would have delayed that bill until the Commerce Secretary published a report on how trade fights with Canada and China, and the war in Iran, affect fishing costs and seafood prices. A Yea would have added that delay; a Nay rejected it.

lobbying.bill_title: To amend the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2023 to extend the time period for which certain regulations concerning the North Atlantic right whale are effective

votes.question: On Agreeing to the Resolution — Providing for the condemnation and denouncement of socialism in all its forms, and for other purposes (H RES 1490)
votes.plain_language: This resolution condemns socialism, including the Democratic Socialists of America, and says the House supports the SAVE America Act and elections limited to U.S. citizens. A Yea agrees. A Nay does not.

lobbying.bill_title: Providing for the condemnation and denouncement of socialism in all its forms, and for other purposes.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Local Access to Courts Act (S 32)
votes.plain_language: This bill adds College Station, Texas, and El Centro, California, as places where specified federal courts must sit. A two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Agreeing to the Resolution — Directing the President, pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution, to remove United States Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran (H CON RES 89)
votes.plain_language: This resolution tells the President to remove U.S. forces from hostilities with Iran unless Congress has declared war or authorized that force, while still allowing defense against an imminent attack. A Yea agrees to that direction. A Nay rejects it.

lobbying.bill_title: Directing the President, pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution, to remove United States Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran

votes.question: On Passage — Stop Insider Trading Act (H R 7008)
votes.bill_title: Stop Insider Trading Act
votes.plain_language: This bill generally bars members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks, and it requires public notice before they sell. A Yea passes it in the House. A Nay votes against passage.

votes.question: On Motion to Recommit — Stop Insider Trading Act (H R 7008)
votes.bill_title: Stop Insider Trading Act
votes.plain_language: The Stop Insider Trading Act would bar members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks and would require public notice before a sale. This vote would have replaced that bill with a broader ban that also forces members, the President, the Vice President, and their spouses and dependent children to sell covered investments they already hold. A Yea would have made that swap; a Nay kept the original bill.

posts.text: This morning, I joined my colleagues in passing the Major Richard Star Act which gives combat-wounded veterans access to both their earned retirement pay and disability compensation. These men and women have served, sacrificed, and defended our nation with honor. The least we can https://t.co/mHdqnYef6B

Perhaps one of the greatest honors of serving in Congress is the opportunity to meet and hear the stories of the very best of our communities – those who chose to wear the uniform. Our country, the freedoms we cherish, and the lives we live today would not be possible without those who made the ultimate sacrifice. There is no greater expression of patriotism or love of country than putting one’s life on the line in service to something greater than oneself.

Today, we are reminded that freedom is never free, and we honor all the veterans and their families who have helped shape our nation’s history through their service and sacrifice.

Happy Veterans Day!

A proven fighter and a unifier. A gifted communicator and advocate for our conservative values. 

The Republican comeback story starts today under Leader @Jim_Jordan. 🇺🇸

Tomorrow, November 10, my office is hosting a free informational session on Medicare and Medicare Open Enrollment to help you understand your coverage options and navigate the enrollment process with confidence.

The session will be led by Sharon Graham, Regional Administrator for the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), at 9 a.m. at the Chambersburg Senior Activity Center.

Four derailments in 10 months is unacceptable. Today, I sent letters to Norfolk Southern and the Federal Railroad Administration demanding answers and accountability to these glaring failures. 

More must be done to ensure the safety of Blair County residents and the passengers

Fighting fraud has been a top priority of mine, especially in my role as the @HouseCommerce Oversight & Investigations Chair.

Today, I’m joining @VP’s anti-fraud pledge – ensuring taxpayer dollars are protected and fraudsters are brought to justice. https://t.co/YyEIVJfBth

Medicare Open Enrollment begins today and runs through December 7! Now is a great opportunity to review your current plan and explore other options to make sure you have the coverage that best meets your needs in the year ahead.

For helpful information, visit https://t.co/8pO1Glxg9x or call 1-800-633-4227. My district offices are also here to help you navigate the process and connect you with resources along the way.

Protecting young athletes from predatory coaches should be nonnegotiable. Yet, investigations into the Amateur Athletic Union have uncovered the organization's negligence in enforcing safety measures and holding accountable those who have reports of sexual abuse against them.

@HouseCommerce is demanding answers and will continue conducting oversight into these allegations.

Three years ago today, Hamas led the deadliest attack on the Jewish people since the Holocaust. The horrific stories and videos from Oct. 7 are still difficult to stomach.

Today, my heart is with the people of Israel as they mourn the innocent young lives murdered and tortured at the hands of terrorists. They have remained resilient in the face of unimaginable evil.

Our support for our ally has not wavered, and we will continue to ensure that Oct. 7 and every life lost that day are never forgotten.

The first weekend of this year’s Apple Harvest Festival in Adams County was a great success. This annual community event is a wonderful way to kick off the fall season with the whole family. 

A special thanks to the over 300 vendors for providing a variety of homegrown treats for everyone to enjoy.

It’s National Manufacturing Day🦺

To all the engineers, welders, assemblers, machine operators, technicians, and others who support American Manufacturing, thank you!

Your talent and dedication are the driving force behind the success of Made in America. https://t.co/JMzyc3k58X

Last night, Senate Democrats rejected the Ratepayer Protection Act, which passed the House with overwhelming bipartisan support. Republicans listened to the concerns of constituents, but Democrats chose obstruction over commonsense relief for the American people. https://t.co/lAvevyk2kR

It’s a great time of year to support our local farmers! During my time in Franklin County, I stopped by Shady Grove Farms to pick up some great-looking pumpkins.

Keep an eye out for farm stands across #PA13 and enjoy what our community’s farmers have grown right here at home. https://t.co/adUtyfONU8

Healthcare workers face more workplace violence than any other profession. That reality is unacceptable, and we must confront it. Last week, I joined @RNAction to talk about how to strengthen protections because the people who care for us deserve to feel safe while doing it. https://t.co/H5DtgyCiXn

Thank you @SecRollins, for investing $145,838 into Family Farm Direct LLC right here in Waynesboro, PA! Our farmers work around the clock to put food on our tables and keep our local economy strong. We'll keep fighting to make sure they get the support they've earned. https://t.co/3ZolqPudcf

Right now, @HouseCommerce's Subcommittee on Health is holding a legislative hearing examining my bipartisan Patients First Act.

This legislation addresses the challenges physicians face in maintaining affordable, high-quality care for their patients. Read what supporters of the Patients First Act are saying: 

https://t.co/oIKFaV0b10

Today, on this solemn day, please join me in remembering our 2,977 fallen heroes whose lives were stolen from us twenty-five years ago in the wake of the 9/11 terrorist attacks.

We remember the bravery and strength of the first responders who ran into danger, the Gold Star families who continue to carry on the legacy of their loved ones, and the heroic Americans, like those aboard Flight 93, who responded to unimaginable circumstances with extraordinary courage and selflessness to protect their fellow Americans.

Twenty-five years ago, we made a promise to never forget. Today, we recommit to that promise and to the shared sense of unity that bonded our nation in the aftermath.

Happy Labor Day, #PA13! Our district runs on the hard work of farmers, manufacturers, engineers, and all the workers who show up every day to build stronger communities and a stronger nation. 

Today, we celebrate your contributions and thank you for a job well done. https://t.co/rhPdvRtsRk

Across the country, we sit on a wealth of resources that remain untapped. Instead, we give that advantage to other countries, strengthening their economies and making America dependent on foreign supply chains.

To truly achieve Made in America, we first need to Mine in America. https://t.co/KVbk2nDldd

After 20+ years practicing medicine in rural communities, I saw firsthand the unique challenges families face when care is out of reach.

That’s why I fought to deliver nearly $200M through @HouseGOP’s Working Families Tax Cuts to expand access to quality care across our state. https://t.co/d5ZXaGBCH6

Last year, Democrats kept the government shutdown for 43 days – the longest in American history. That was a lesson learned moment.

Just now, @HouseGOP acted to extend funding through December, keeping the government open and avoiding the costs and consequences of another shutdown.

Students and educators are heading back to the classroom for another great year of learning.

Under @POTUS, parents are back in the driver’s seat, school choice is expanding, and curriculum is refocusing on education over indoctrination.

Republicans will always fight for the opportunities America's children need to succeed.

https://t.co/59n1KDx8Lk
Every family deserves access to quality care close to home. Proud to have helped pass the Working Families Tax Cut to make that a reality for rural communities across #PA13. https://t.co/Z5HHnDEgNo

Today, I had the privilege of joining the Shippensburg community to celebrate Volvo Construction Equipment’s $40 million investment to bring more production home, strengthen domestic supply chains, and create new opportunities for Pennsylvania workers.

Volvo is leading the way in revitalizing American manufacturing and investing in our exceptionally skilled workforce that makes it possible.

This is a win for Pennsylvania and a win for America.

My office is now accepting applications from students seeking a nomination to one of our nation’s prestigious service academies. Applications for nominations will be received through November 1.

Interested in serving our nation? Learn more about the application process and eligibility requirements:

https://t.co/a5D9NL8mRl

Great news for our local veterans: The Department of Veterans Affairs recently approved $9.7 million to improve healthcare infrastructure at the James E. Van Zandt VA Medical Center in Altoona.

These maintenance projects, replacements, and facility upgrades will help maintain operational capability and advance healthcare delivery for the veterans who rely on this medical center.

This morning, I had the honor of joining the @PennStateWREST team at the White House!

Penn State is proud to be home to a consistently exceptional athletic program, developing champions like @NoBickal and so many others.

Great young men, guided by one of the best coaching staffs in the country in Coach Sanderson and his team.

The August District Work Period is always a highlight of the year, giving me the chance to be home and travel throughout PA-13.

Last week's stops took me across Cambria County to connect with community leaders and local businesses, including the Southmont Borough Volunteer Fire Department, Watkins Security, the Cambria County Library, and Johnstown City Hall.

Great conversations with the people who keep our communities strong!
Happy Birthday to Vice President JD Vance! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/5MlLX3iAsh

Dr. Fauci already received a full pardon from Biden.

Pleading the 5th today was a choice to dodge accountability instead of giving the American people the straight answers they deserve.

https://t.co/HYjoMaDyjv
